verdict.rationale: Slack's first-party Workflow Builder lets any user combine triggers and steps into no-code automations. It adds webhook triggers for events from outside Slack and conditional branching. Code-defined workflows are available through the Deno Slack SDK, and the Events API backs event-driven apps. Missing for 10: an enumeration of which in-Slack events can trigger workflows, the depth beyond the 'limited set of steps and triggers', and independent or hands-on corroboration.
